Spell casters in Bane of Azeroth uses the same spell casting rules and spells as are presented in the core rules. If you have access to The Book of Magic, feel free to use the rules and spells from that book instead (at the DMs discretion). In addition, this chapter adds spells that fit well in the world of Azeroth.

Heroic Ability Spells

Heroic Ability Spells are General Magic spells that can only be gained by selecting the corresponding heroic ability from the Heroic Class Abilities chapter.

@DisplaySpellRef[boa:item.spells.incarnation-of-the-stars]{Incarnation of the Stars}

Elementalism Spells

In order to better represent the mages of Azeroth, primarily the frost and arcane mages, this book adds a set of elementalist spells to help fill that fantasy. This does not mean that they are exlusive to mages, and a Shaman could pick up @Ref[boa:item.spells.frost-bolt]{Frost Bolt} to fill the fantasy of frost shock, for example. In addition to the below spells, add @Ref[boa:item.spells.frost-bolt]{Frost Bolt} as an optional prerequisite to @Ref[dragonbane-core:spell.undine]{Undine}. If Book of Magic is used, add @Ref[dragonbane-core:spell.undine]{Undine} as an optional prerequisite to @Ref[dragonbane-book-of-magic:spell.hailstorm]{Hailstorm} and @Ref[boa:item.spells.arcane-orb]{Arcane Orb} as an optional prerequisite for @Ref[dragonbane-book-of-magic:spell.conjure]{Conjure}.
